mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with a light drizzle near Harriet Park and we are seeing a third quarter moon. Expect a low of 55 degrees tonight with rain in the forecast.

The city has updated its erosion control and stormwater management permit process, requiring a pre-application meeting for specific projects. Additionally, asphalt repairs are scheduled for November 9 and 10 on North Nine Mound Road and other areas.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee.
On October 25, a 40-year-old Verona man was arrested for O W I after being found passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the delicious Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is open and serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
